mechanics.title: Creating an area
mechanics.description: Place a sign with a radius prefix such as [R:10] (or [Radius:10]) on one line and the area name on another; an optional [RGB] prefix sets a custom message color. Leave the radius empty to use the default (30 blocks); a blank name gets a random name (default on). Breaking the sign removes the area.

mechanics.title: Overlap
mechanics.description: Areas may overlap to form other shapes; the enter/leave message only shows when entering the first or leaving the last overlapping area.

mechanics.title: Config
mechanics.description: Signs are checked within 100 blocks of the player by default. Enter/leave prefixes, chat vs HUD messages, and text color/size are configurable.

commands_and_keybinds: /areas - lists all area signs around the player
getting_started: Place a sign, write [R:20] on one line and a name on another, and walk across the boundary.
editor_notes: Exact line layout of the sign is approximate (from Modrinth page examples; screenshots not readable). Modrinth lists client required / server unsupported: players need the mod client-side. Requires Collective.
name: Areas
summary: Lets any player define a named area (town, base, region) by placing a sign. Walking into or out of the radius shows a message at the top of the screen, such as 'Entering Desert Island.'
